episodes.instruction: Let's prepare for gardening. Move the plant containers and basket from the living room to the kitchen. Then place the hammers next to the basket. Finally dust the hammers.
Let's clean the shelves. Put the books on the floor. Then, clean each book and clean the shelves. Finally arrange the books back back on the shelves after cleaning.
Let's make smoothies. Move the jug and toy fruits to the kitchen, and wash them. Place 2 glasses on the coffee table.
Move the kettle from the living room to the kitchen counter, fill it with water and turn it on. After that, place the cups on the counter next to the kettle.
Once I dust the shelves in the living room, let's arrange all of the books on them.
Let's make coffee. Move the electric kettle and a can to the kitchen counter? I'll fill the kettle with water and turn it on. Place two mugs on the living room table while the coffee brews.
Let's clean the office. Move the sponge and soap dispenser to the office. I'll clean the table with them. Also, let's move the towels to the bathroom.
Let's clean the kitchen. Move the dishes to the kitchen, while I wipe down the counters.
Let's organize the closet. Move all the cans to the kitchen counter, while I clean cabinet? Then arrange the cans back on the cabinet once I'm done?
Move all the toys on the couches to a nearby table. Let's also dust them because they are dirty.
Move all of the plates from the dining table to the kitchen and I'll clean the table.
Let me clean the shoes in the chest of drawers. They can all be moved to the entryway once clean.
Move the laptop and the mouse pad to the living room. I'll turn on the laptop once its there.
Move all of the dirty dishes to the kitchen. I'll wipe down the dining table with the sponge.
Let's clean up after dinner. Can we put all the dirty dishes in the kitchen so that I can clean them? As I clean the dishes, put them on the kitchen table.
Clean the spatula and place the casserole and spatula on the kitchen table.
It's time to go to bed. Let's turn off all the lamps in the living room. Also bring a book from the living room and a filled glass of water from the kitchen to the bedroom.

Help me set up for a party. Move 3 filled water bottles and a filled pitcher from the kitchen table to the fridge for chilled water. Set a vase on the living room table and 4 bowls for snacks on the living room table.
Place the toy fruits and vase on the large oak table. I will clean the bed.
Place the hammer on the toilet while I scrub the toilet.
Begin by moving all the books from the living room to the bedroom. Then, dust each book and arrange them on the chest of drawers.
Clear up the dining table by bringing the items to the kitchen. I will wash them one by one.
Move the dirty bath towels from the bedroom to the laundry room. I will clean them.
Please bring a filled water bottle, laptop cover, mousepad and a backpack to the living room.
Fill the jug with water and then empty it. Store the jug in the kitchen cabinet when you are done.

Let's setup for dinner. Fill the pitcher on the kitchen counter with water and put it in the fridge so that we can have chilled water with dinner. Also, wipe the dinner table and take two plates, two bowls, and two glasses from the kitchen cabinet and set them on the table?
Move the jug, kettle, teapot, and cup from the dining table to the kitchen and fill all with water. Turn on the lamp, and clean the dining table.
Move the spatula, ladle, and fork from the kitchen counter to the dining table. Clean the kitchen counter.
Move the vase, picture frame, and candle from the living room table to the bedroom cabinet. Turn off the lamp.
